jobs.title: Founding UI/UX Artist, Unannounced Game
jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social. As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey! Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell. What You'll Be Doing UX flow design for entire game experience Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance Discover and manage external partners where needed What You Have 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists Passionate about both UI & UX design Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.) Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge. Would Be Nice

Collaborate with the creative team in developing innovative e-learning materials. jobs.description: The role HelloFresh is going AI-first. Join us in leading the shift and shaping the global customer experience. As a Senior UX Strategist & Researcher on our UX team, you ll own work from ambiguous brief to strategic outcome and implementation — defining project needs, using innovative research approaches, prototyping direction instead of presenting findings, and walking into executive meetings with a decision artifact, not a summary. The most valued teammates today aren t the ones who run the most studies. They shape which questions get asked, challenge business assumptions before money is spent, and stay in the room to drive the decision.  You ll use AI fluently as a genuine creative and strategic partner throughout the product design lifecycle. Strategy and research are your deepest strengths, but you’ll also work across the wider UX practice. We’re looking for people who go deep in one area and can take interface design, service design, and content to a solid minimum quality standard on their own, using AI to move fast, and who know when a problem needs a specialist’s depth. Above all, we are looking for people who will  make HelloFresh   better.  We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you. Shape experiences across the ecosystem: Partner with product, design, marketing, operations, and business teams to understand and shape experiences across the full customer and service ecosystem. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Mobile
jobs.description: About Us: Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us. About the Role: As Senior Product Designer, you will define how AI feels for the teams building our homes. You'll shape the experiences that our Superintendents and Direct Construction Operators (DCOs) rely on every day - across our mobile application, advanced AI based video analysis, and new experiences around automated data capture on site. This is a role for a designer who blends sharp interaction design with strong visual craft. You'll take novel, sometimes ambiguous AI capabilities - computer vision, multimodal models, agents - and turn them into interfaces that feel clear, trustworthy, and genuinely delightful on a jobsite. You know the emerging patterns for designing with AI (surfacing confidence, handling uncertainty, guiding and correcting the model) and you have a point of view on how to make them feel effortless for users who are not sitting at a desk. Motion design won't be your day-to-day focus, but you can reach for it to bring AI experiences to life and make them compelling. Just as importantly, you're an exceptional communicator: helping craft executive level presentations that carry Homebound's AI narrative

jobs.title: UX Product Designer
jobs.description: We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day. Our Mission Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere. Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended. This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it. Your Role As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will: Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App. Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution. Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed? Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk. Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned. jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM At Mural , we’re reimagining how teams think and create together. The Design and Research team brings clarity to complexity, shaping experiences that help people collaborate, ideate, and solve problems visually. We partner deeply with engineering, product, and research to invent the next generation of collaborative work combining craft, systems thinking, and bold exploration. YOUR MISSION As a Lead Product Designer focused on Growth, you’ll define how Mural earns user trust at the moments that matter most when someone first encounters the product's value, decides to go deeper, or chooses to stay. This is end to end growth journey ownership. It's about designing the logic of how Mural grows: the moments where clarity converts, where friction is a design failure, and where the line between growth and product quality either holds or breaks. You'll work across discovery, activation, and pricing surfaces, onboarding paths, upgrade flows, lifecycle touchpoints, and in-product nudges. Most importantly, you'll orchestrate how those surfaces work together and set the standard for how growth design is practiced at Mural. You'll succeed if you can bring full journey thinking, rigor and craft to a domain that often defaults to shortcuts and if you can help a cross-functional team understand what good growth design actually looks like. Work from concept to production, delivering thoughtful UX, polished visual design, and vibe coded prototypes that help the organization understand direction, risk, and value. jobs.description: About us Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce. We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API. We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the self-serve product experience for our SMB customers: small to medium brands selling on Shopify and beyond. The proposition for this segment is unbuilt, the squad is yours to shape, and you'll own the slice of ARR that comes with it. Working closely with engineers, designers, and AI researchers, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships Location: Paris, hybrid 3 days in the office. We offer relocation support About the role Own a real slice of the self-serve product. From idea to shipped feature, you will build and execute the roadmap that solves problems for our users. Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the user problem, then partner with design and engineering to ship work that feels effortless. Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue. Stay close to the user. Talk to e-commerce sellers every week, and feed what you hear directly into roadmap decisions. Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won’t need to wait around for someone else to run the query. jobs.description: Landsiedel Seminare ist in Deutschlands führender Anbieter von NLP Seminaren, Ausbildungen und Online-Akademie. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, ihre Potentiale zu entdecken, zu entwickeln, und den Mut zu haben, sie auch "auszuleben", um ein erfülltes und glückliches Leben zu führen. Neurolinguistisches Programmieren (NLP) hat das Potenzial, eine transformative Rolle dabei zu spielen, die Welt zu einem besseren Ort zu machen, indem es die Art und Weise verbessert, wie Menschen kommunizieren, denken, und handeln. Als Design-Praktikant*in kannst Du beim Rollout des internationalen NLP-Magazins „World of NLP“ mitwirken und unsere Social Media Auftritte in mehreren Sprachen sowie unsere internationale Webseite von Anfang an mitgestalten. Wir bieten ein Pflicht-Praktikum in einem dynamischen Team, mit eigenem, adäquat ausgestattetem Arbeitsplatz in unserem Institut in Kitzingen oder remote (also von Zuhause aus mit Kommunikation über Zoom, E-Mail, Telefon). Bitte nur bewerben, wenn es wirklich ein von der Uni oder Hochschule vorgeschriebenes Pflichtpraktikum in Vollzeit ist. Aufgaben Du unterstützt uns im Rollout des Online-Magazins durch Deine Mitarbeit im Design (Arbeit mit InDesign) und bei der optischen Gestaltung des Web-Auftritts Du entwickelst das Online-Magazin aktiv mit, indem Du die Redaktion und unsere Grafik-Designerin in ihren Aufgaben unterstützt und die Texte in ansprechende Designs und Layouts umsetzt Du übernimmst die Erstellung und Bearbeitung von visuellem Content (z.B. für Social Media und die Webseite) Du bearbeitest, optimierst und erstellst Bildmaterial Gerne erhältst Du auch Einblicke in unsere Online-Marketing-Aktivitäten und kannst diese mitgestalten Gerne gesehen und vermittelt wird auch der Einsatz von KI Qualifikation Studiengang im Bereich Graphik / Design / Medien Management / Marketing / Kommunikation oder vergleichbare Du verfügst über erste Kenntnisse in der Adobe Creative Cloud, insbesondere in Bezug auf InDesign.

jobs.description: Du hast schon mehr als ein paar Figma-Tutorials hinter dir, kommunizierst klar und nutzt KI selbstverständlich in deinem Designalltag? Dann steig ein bei BlickSolutions, einer Shopify-Agentur, die E-Commerce neu denkt. Wir gestalten nicht einfach Interfaces, wir kreieren. Und wir suchen dich, um spannende Shopify- und App-Projekte auf das nächste Level zu bringen. Deine Aufgaben Du gestaltest und entwickelst Benutzeroberflächen für Shopify-Shops und mobile Apps weiter. Du erstellst Wireframes, Mockups und interaktive Prototypen in Figma. Du setzt Designsysteme und Richtlinien konsequent um, damit alles aus einem Guss wirkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung und Projektmanagement zusammen und erklärst deine Entscheidungen verständlich. Du erarbeitest eigenständig Designlösungen auf Basis von Projektanforderungen und Nutzerfeedback. Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, um schneller und besser zu arbeiten (Ideenfindung, Varianten, Recherche, Prototyping). Das bringst du mit Du bist eingeschrieben in Design, Medieninformatik oder einem verwandten Fach. Du hast nachweisliche UX/UI-Erfahrung, zum Beispiel aus Praktika, Freelance-Jobs oder echten Projekten. Dein Portfolio zeigt, was du kannst. Du beherrschst Figma souverän: schnelle, saubere Umsetzung statt Rumprobieren. Du denkst AI first: KI-Tools gehören für dich zum Workflow, und du bleibst neugierig auf neue Entwicklungen. Du kommunizierst klar, offen und auf Augenhöhe, auch remote. Du bist motiviert, willst Verantwortung übernehmen und im Team über dich hinauswachsen. Erfahrung mit Shopify oder App-Design ist ein Plus. Leistungen Das bieten wir dir Remote first: 100 % ortsunabhängig arbeiten. Flexibilität: Du teilst dir deine 15-20 Stunden so ein, dass sie zu Studium und Leben passen. Bei uns zählt, was du leistest, nicht wie lange du am Schreibtisch sitzt. Echte Projekte: Deine Designs landen bei echten Kunden, nicht in der Schublade. Mentoring: Berufliches und persönliches Wachstum gehören bei uns dazu. Teamkultur: Humor
